text: Meet Fire The DJ. Your AI DJ for every party.
head: Meet FireTheDJ
sub: Your AI DJ for every party

text: Add your music. Songs on your phone, YouTube Music playlists, or any playlist link. Fire The DJ listens to every track, right on your device, to learn its tempo, key, beats and drops.
head: Bring your music
sub: Tempo, key, beats and drops, analysed on your device

text: Pick a crate, choose Smooth or Trickster, and press start. That's it. The AI takes over.
head: Pick a crate. Press start.

text: It picks the next song, matches the beats, and plans every transition. Bass swaps, echo outs, loop builds and drum fill cuts, all styled to the genre that's playing.
head: Every mix, planned

text: New in version 1.3: lyrics on screen. Beat Pop drops each word on the beat, with the hook in flames.
head: New: lyrics on screen

text: Karaoke lights up every word as it's sung. And when two songs share a word, Fire The DJ mixes right on it.
head: Sing along

text: Playing Telugu or other Indian music? You'll hear dappu, dhol and nadaswaram fills, right in the mix.
head: Made for Indian parties

text: Put it on your TV for full screen visuals, and update right from the app. More features are in progress.
head: Big screen ready

text: To get it, open the GitHub page for Fire The DJ and download the latest release. On Android TV, open the Downloader app and enter the code 8 9 2 3 5 1 9.
head: Download free

text: Fire The DJ is free, open source, and has no ads. If you like it, you can support it from Settings, under Support Fire The DJ.
head: Like it? Support it.
sub:
Settings › Support FireTheDJ
Free · Open source · No ads
